_about: Copy-paste answers for affiliate and partner signups, shown with tap-to-copy buttons at /hq/signup (movietrailer.channel). Never put ABN, TFN, bank or card details here: type those only into the vendor's own form.

common.Traffic sources: Organic search (Google, Bing) and social sharing. No paid search on brand terms, no coupons, no incentivised traffic.
common.Disclosure: Every page with affiliate links carries a clear disclosure, and each site has a dedicated affiliate disclosure page.

fields.Audience: Australians, mostly Melbourne-based, planning weekends away, day trips and road trips in Victoria.
fields.Site description: Vic Tours (victours.com.au) is an independent, town-by-town travel guide to Victoria, Australia, published in Melbourne by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd. It covers 61 towns and Melbourne neighbourhoods with where to stay, where to eat and what to do, plus day-by-day road trips and 49 ready-made weekend plans (by train, on a budget, for couples and for families).
fields.How you'll promote (stays): Clearly labelled booking links on each town's "Where to stay" page and inside our weekend plans and road trips, so readers can book accommodation that fits the trip they're planning. Links are disclosed on every page. No brand bidding, coupons or incentivised traffic.
fields.How you'll promote (tours): Clearly labelled tour and activity links on each town's things-to-do pages and inside our weekend plans and road-trip itineraries. Links are disclosed on every page. No brand bidding, coupons or incentivised traffic.
fields.How you'll promote (car hire): Clearly labelled car-hire links inside our self-drive road trips and weekend plans, where readers need a car to follow the route. Links are disclosed on every page. No brand bidding, coupons or incentivised traffic.
fields.Strengths / why us: High-intent planning pages: every town has dedicated stay, eat and do pages built from real local data, and our weekend plans target searches like "train to Geelong" (1,900/month) and "cheap accommodation Ballarat" (590/month).

fields.Audience: Movie fans, mostly in the US, deciding what to watch tonight and where to stream, rent or buy it.
fields.Site description: MovieTrailer.Channel is a movie guide with the official trailer for each film plus where to watch it: stream, rent or buy. It covers 240+ films and curated collections (seasonal, decades, directors), published by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd.
fields.How you'll promote: Clearly labelled "Watch now" and "where to watch" links on each film page and inside our collections, next to the trailer, for people deciding what to watch. Links are disclosed on every page. No brand bidding, coupons or incentivised traffic.
fields.Strengths / why us: Every page targets "where to watch [film]" searches, which are about five times more common than "[film] trailer" searches, and the reader is one click from renting.

fields.Site type / category: Content site · Free business tools for Australian tradies
fields.Audience: Australian tradies, mostly sole traders and small teams (1–10 people): plumbers, electricians, builders, carpenters and other trades who quote and invoice from their phone and are outgrowing paper, Word templates or spreadsheets.
fields.Site description: Trade Admin (tradeadmin.com.au) gives Australian tradies free admin tools: a quote builder and an invoice builder that follow ATO tax-invoice rules, run in the browser and turn a quote into an invoice in one tap. It also publishes plain-English job management software comparisons (Fergus, Tradify, ServiceM8) with a cost calculator, using only each vendor's own published Australian prices, dated. Published in Melbourne by Independent Media Network Pty Ltd.
fields.How you'll promote: Clearly labelled links on our job management software comparison, our pricing page for your app and our head-to-head comparisons, each with a cost calculator for the reader's team size and job volume. Next, a short "ready for a proper job app?" prompt for tradies who have just made a quote or invoice with our free tools. Links are disclosed on every page and on our How we make money page. No bidding on your brand terms, no coupons, no incentivised traffic, and no claims beyond your own published pricing and features.
fields.Strengths / why us: We reach tradies at the exact moment they feel the admin pain: people searching for a free invoice template (14,800 searches a month in Australia) or quote template (2,400) and using our builders. Our comparisons are honest and dated, so readers trust the recommendation.
fields.Monthly visitors: New site, launched 25 October 2026; growing organic search traffic.
fields.Current clients / tradies you work with: None directly: we're a publisher, not a consultant. Referrals come from readers of tradeadmin.com.au who click through and sign up themselves.
